```yaml
name: Deploy Docker Image

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Deployment environment'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
    outputs:
      short_sha: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.SHORT_SHA }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Compute short SHA
        id: vars
        run: echo "SHORT_SHA=${GITHUB_SHA::7}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/questarr:${{ steps.vars.outputs.SHORT_SHA }}
            ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/questarr:latest

      - name: Deploy container
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name questarr \
            -p 80:80 \
            -e HOST=0.0.0.0 \
            -e PRODUCTION_API_KEY=${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_API_KEY }} \
            ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/questarr:${{ steps.vars.outputs.SHORT_SHA }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  notify:
    needs: build-and-push
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify success
        run: |
          echo "Deployment of ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/questarr:${{ needs.build-and-push.outputs.short_sha }} to ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }} completed."
```
